overwrites.headline: Mechanical Engineer | Design, safety, and documentation
overwrites.summary: Mechanical Engineering graduate with hands-on experience in AutoCAD facility design, safety inspection, and technical documentation. Drafted facility layouts and emergency egress plans to code, inspected life-safety equipment against OSH requirements, and audited university property. Also builds software, including a unit-aware equation solver used for licensure exam review. Seeking a mechanical design, facilities, or safety engineering role.

label: Mechanical Engineering
blurb: Leads with the mechanical subjects. Facilities, design, and safety roles.

overwrites.headline: Software developer | Backend services, infrastructure, and embedded systems
overwrites.summary: Self-taught developer with a Mechanical Engineering degree and five applications built, deployed, and running on a self-hosted server. Writes Python and TypeScript, designs MySQL schemas, and owns each project end to end: architecture, implementation, tests, and the deployment it runs on. Comfortable with Linux, Docker, and the parts of a system that are not the interesting feature. Looking for a software or systems development role, and willing to learn whatever the codebase is written in.

label: Software
blurb: Leads with the largest build and the infrastructure work. Software and systems roles.
